name: lib_matrix_ker_mulVecLin_le_ker_mul
statement: (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] (m n p : Type*) [Fintype n] [Fintype p] (M : Matrix m n R) (N : Matrix n p R) : LinearMap.ker N.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.ker (M * N).mulVecLin
closed: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] (m n p : Type*) [Fintype n] [Fintype p] (M : Matrix m n R) (N : Matrix n p R), LinearMap.ker N.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.ker (M * N).mulVecLin
informal: Null space of a product: ker N ≤ ker (M * N), over any commutative semiring (dual companion of range (M * N) ≤ range M). Promoted and generalised from Mathlib2.bld3_rank_tripotent_defect_aux1 (kernel companion; used inline in rank-defect proofs).
